fidelity_receipt.claim: The stored extracted foreground reached the composite unchanged: every fully opaque foreground pixel in the composite is identical to the stored foreground layer (foreground hashes above pin that layer). The composite carries the source photo's colour profile unchanged (color_profile_preserved above); a profile change is a fidelity failure even when pixel values match.
